name: Phone Operator
description: Observe and control Android phone UI through the Nous accessibility bridge, with SSH fallback tools for device info, app list, and screenshots.
success_criteria: Observe the phone UI before any click/type action.
Use phone_act only with a clear user intent and after safety confirmation.
Observe again after each phone action to verify the result.
instruction: Current Skill: Phone Operator. First use phone_observe to inspect the active Android UI tree. Use phone_act for click, long_click, type, scroll, back, and home only when the intent is clear; after every action, call phone_observe again to verify. Use phone_info, phone_app_list, phone_screenshot, and image_analyze as fallback or extra context.
